UNCHANGED HINGE, ONE LEG PARTIALLY CLEARED AND NOW NEARER RESOLUTION — whether the H2 FY2027 ORGANIC subscription re-acceleration prints ex-M&. The Q2 FY27 print did clear the bookings half: cRPO came in "one point ahead of our guide" at 14% cc (vs the ~13% cc guided on the Q1 call) and net new AOV growth is "the strongest in four years", which retires the "merely met guide two quarters running" objection. It did NOT clear the organic half: the $300M cc guide raise is only $100M organic, with $200M from the unclosed Contentful and Fin deals and a $100M FX headwind exactly offsetting the organ
